FN-11JCGLL-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 542
Committee: Transportation, Utilities and Sponsor: Representative Chris Blackshear
Infrastructure
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 03/10/2026
House Bill 542 introduced would increase the obligations of the Alabama Department of
Transportation (ALDOT) paid from the Public Road and Bridge Fund, beginning in Fiscal Year
2027, by up to $10 million annually to reimburse utilities with gross annual income over $250
million for the costs of relocating certain utility facilities, pursuant to the provisions of this bill.
This bill would also require the department to reimburse a minimum of $20 million total
annually to utilities with gross annual income of up to $250 million annually for such utility
relocation costs. This provision could further increase the obligations of ALDOT by an
undetermined amount dependent any additional relocation cost reimbursements required to be
paid to meet this threshold that would otherwise not be paid under current law. According to
ALDOT, the average amount of utility relocation costs advanced by the department is $20
million total annually.
